text:
maria: Quick kickoff for "Watchtower" onboarding playbook. Objective: minimal observability surface for new pilots — single overview, per-route cost rollups, and basic error-slice alerts. Need owners + hard launch gates.
liam: Can we keep the dashboard to one page? Customers hate hunting. Propose Overview + one drill pane for traces.
zoe: UX will deliver Overview (latency p50/p95/p99, sampled cost, error-rate by route) and a compact drill that shows 3 example traces. No custom dashboards for alpha.
hamid: Runtime notes: add span tags: model, route, tenant, token_count, quant_mode. Default sampling 0.5% (to be conservative) + force-capture on error. Also add X-RW-SAMPLE header for QA.
sara: Finance asked for per-route 7d rollups CSV. For alpha we can provide admin-only CSV exported on-demand. Accuracy target: within 8% of billing on pilot data.
telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: schema v0.4 published -> https://internal/telemetry/schemas/v0.4
liam: Perf guardrails: tracing hook must add <1% median latency. If we can't meet that, reduce sample to 0.1% and rely on post-aggregation.
hamid: Implementation plan: 1) small runtime hook to emit metadata, batched producer. 2) gateway flag for per-route override. 3) backfill job that reconciles sampled cost to billing. Estimate 3 sprints total but alpha can be trimmed to 2.
omitted: (typo)
maria: Owners: product=maria, eng=hamid, ux=zoe, finance=sara, infra=liam. Timeline: alpha in 5 weeks. Launch gates we need to agree on now.
liam: Proposed gates:
 - A: Overview displays pilot traffic with correct route tagging
 - B: Trace metadata emitted and sampled traces arrive in pipeline
 - C: CSV export produces correct 7d rollup for pilot (finance sign-off)
 - D: Error-slice alerts firing for at least 2 common slices
 - E: Canary plan + rollback doc in ops runbook
 - F: Perf: median overhead <1% and p99 tail impact measured <3%
zoe: UX asks: we'll include microcopy for sampling and a small explainer on cost estimator. Also a "why you see fewer traces" tooltip.
sara: Finance: CSV for alpha can be limited fields: route_id, total_tokens, est_cost, requests. No PII. Admin-only export.
ops-bot: ops-bot: feature-flag "watchtower-alpha" created. Canary rule template created (2% traffic, region=us-east).
hamid: One technical constraint: token_count must be emitted as integer span tag and capped at 4096 to avoid weird payloads. I'll enforce that in runtime.
maria: Decision: lock scope to Overview + trace tags + sampled rollups + admin CSV + alerts. Owners file short RFCs with perf test plans by EOD Thursday.
liam: I'll add telemetry sizing estimate and topic retention (7d) to the RFC.
zoe: Mock ready Wednesday lunchtime.
sara: I'll prep finance acceptance checklist.
maria: Thanks. Sync Friday 11am to sign-off. :rocket:
